title: Tempo
description: A lyric edit with no footage: sincere lines set word by word in white Arial on black, each word landing on the kick of herb's Friday beat and the force-justified block re-spreading as it arrives, then smearing away on sixteenths at the end of the phrase. Tap to restart a line, type your own and it lands on the beat.
intent: Justify's world driven by time: the beat grid of friday-beat.wav (120 BPM, kick on every beat) is the clock, every word is scheduled against the AudioContext output timestamp, and the same grid runs silently on the performance clock before sound starts so the piece is already in time at load.
sources: herb reference board: 70e084cd (LA skyline, lyric built word by word into a justified block that clears at phrase end)
herb reference board: cfcf1930 (words arriving with stuttered motion smear into a justified block)
